dimensions.description: Revenue of all orders of the customer

dimensions.name: lifetime_tier
dimensions.title: Customers Lifetime Tier
dimensions.sql:
CASE
  WHEN ${lifetime_revenue} >= 30000 THEN 'high'
  WHEN ${lifetime_revenue} >= 10000 THEN 'medium'
  ELSE 'low'
END

dimensions.name: price_band
dimensions.title: Products Price Band
dimensions.sql:

  WHEN ${CUBE}.PRICE < 10 THEN 'budget'
  WHEN ${CUBE}.PRICE < 30 THEN 'standard'
  ELSE 'premium'
END
